tagline: 宝丽来旁轴相机，1975 年发布
description: 宝丽来于1975年推出的旁轴相机。

specs.英文简介: One of many models of rigid, plastic bodied, colour packfilm cameras Polaroid produced in the 60s and 70s at consumer-range prices, the Colorpack is designed only for the (now discontinued) 80-series packfilm yielding square images.
